fusions.name: Call to Order
fusions.desc: Strikes the ground with the butt of the rod; the tremor deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Realm's Weight
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: This Far, No Further
fusions.desc: Raises a ridge of stone 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: King's Highway
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
